qualification_scope: Windows native local synthetic/loopback candidate only

source_snapshot.manifest_encoding: sorted compact ensure_ascii JSON path-to-sha256; ASCII bytes; no newline

selector.enumeration: Git cached plus untracked paths, exclude-standard, restricted to scopes
selector.deleted_tracked_paths: omitted when no actual file exists
selector.symlinks_and_reparse_points: rejected for selected files and ancestors

source_snapshot.scope_note: All 167 actual selected current-tree files were inventoried and rehashed, not merely the previously selected 25. The complete immutable path-to-hash map is published. This selector is not every build input or dependency; docs/evidence are outside it.

results.count_note: 376 passes per toolchain are repeated executions, not 752 distinct tests. Ignored/filtered/skipped/xfailed cases are not executed passes. Example, feature-off, targeted and subtest results overlap other cases and are not added to a unique-test total.

tcp_connection_unit_tests.count_note: Exact log entries under this prefix only; not every transport or TCP integration test.

independent_pyav.count_note: One exact explicitly enabled ignored test internally covers 19 x 3 containers; 57 is source-derived, not 57 separately reported test passes.

audio_boundary.scope_note: Only these three package names in production normal/build Cargo graphs are checked. Dev dependencies are excluded. No PE audit or general binary-dependency absence claim.

release_binary_identity.scope_note: The preserved private audio copy was freshly hashed and matches the recorded tested audio binary. The minimal build overwrote the shared release CLI location afterward. Minimal/PCM hashes describe report-time identities only; no executable was run, and no PE/import/dependency audit is claimed.

historical_r2_count_comparison.scope_note: Historical R2 remains the earlier proof for its earlier source; the R3 count was recomputed, not inherited or relabeled.

linux.scope_note: Current Linux R2 used the same 167-file manifest and remains FAILED: the release-finalization test failed and three later phases were not run. A passing Linux workspace alone is not qualification of its whole requested scope. Windows R3 success does not relabel Linux or any historical attempt.

harness_safeguards.scope_note: Reported execution-gate release and empty jobs without capture/cleanup/spawn/containment/time/output-limit errors are harness safeguards, not mathematical sandbox proof. No new selftest execution is claimed.

limits: Local synthetic and loopback Windows evidence only; no remote Rambler service, device or Android parity qualification.
No language, intent, access-recovery, WAN, universal speed, perfection or complete-platform claim.
Publication verifies existing report/log bytes, source manifests and the preserved audio copy; it does not rerun tests, build, execute binaries, access the network or use ADB.

Only explicit allowlisted metadata, public repository-relative source paths and hashes are published: no private absolute paths, raw logs, payloads, PCM, recognition text, account identifiers or secrets.
Source equality is bounded to the reproduced 167-file selector and does not cover every external build input, environment or dependency.
Linux current scope is independently FAILED despite matching selected source bytes; no overall cross-platform qualification is claimed.
